subject: Insurance
title: Space Insurance Frontier
description: A micro-lesson that makes Space Insurance Frontier usable.

discovery.text: Lloyd's of London dominates space insurance, covering launches since the 1960s.

twist.text: SpaceX's reusable rockets are reshaping space insurance.

climax.text: Space insurance will grow as commercial space tourism and satellite mega-constellations expand the market.

punchline.text: $100 million launch, 5-20% premium. Space is insured from the launch pad up.

quiz.question: How is SpaceX affecting the space insurance market?
options: Reusable rockets are driving premiums down due to higher reliability
